batting.name: SP Narine
batting.dismissal: c JM Bairstow b RD Chahar

batting.name: AD Russell
batting.dismissal: c HV Patel b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: SS Iyer
batting.dismissal: c K Rabada b Arshdeep Singh

batting.name: RK Singh
batting.dismissal: c Ashutosh Sharma b HV Patel

batting.name: RR Rossouw
batting.dismissal: c SS Iyer b SP Narine

balls.text: cutter outside off just inside the line, Venkatesh misses the big swing and he's run out after venturing out because Ramandeep doesn't run. Oh hello! The umpire has given it wide but it wasn't and is reviewed immediately. Changed to a legal delivery and KKR end on 261
too full and wide outside off, he chases and misses. Wide again
misses the big swing off a slower ball, they want to sneak in a bye and there's a direct hit at the bowler's end but replays show he's in
he pulls the length slightly shorter for a slower one, pulls and misses. They review for a wide, but the offcutter comes in and it's not a wide
Harshal goes wide, Ramandeep follows it, goes down on a knee and absolutely pummels that straight down the ground for a six! That was as straight as an arrow, spectacular shot
wants to smoke it away from outside off, but he doesn't middle it and Ashutosh takes a really good catch while running backwards at from short third
they go past 250 as Rinku reaches out for the wide and low full toss and gets a thick edge to deep third for four in the gap
attempted yorker is a low full toss on off, chipped down to long-on for wo
wide again outside off, he goes down to drill it to long-off
138kmh, quick and straight outside off as Rinku switches for a reverse. He's beaten completely
it didn't look threatening at all but the wide and full ball has done it. Shreyas had to reach out for it and scythed it straight to deep third
swinging in late just wide of the stumps, he bunts it down to long-off
over the covers and that's another six! Venkatesh gets into the act by reaching out for the wide ball outside off and slamming it over cover
back to the off side and that's six too! Wide and full, he stays deep inside and scythes that away square on the off side. This one lands in the crowd too
the best of the lot and it goes all the way! He moves towards off, Curran bowls it full on the stumps and Shreyas flicks it away with some style. Great timing for the second six of the over
wide and full outside off and Shreyas can feast on those the whole day! Middles the cover drive over the fielder and gets a one-bounce four
he finally middles the short ball and it has more than enough to go sailing over deep square leg all the way!
hint of late inswing for the full ball outside off, he smashes it down to long-off
gets the yorker right on middle, Shreyas gets only one down the ground
124.7kmh, slightly slow and outside off, Shreyas miscues the pull behind square this time for one
Venkatesh is not middling many tonight, miscues one over square leg off a short ball for one
touch closer to off and slapped to cover this time
stays still inside the crease for the ball angling away from well outside off and he unleashes a whippy slap on the off side over the covers in the gap
slow short ball and Venkatesh is foxed a little while pulling that one after coming down the pitch, but he gets two
slightly wide and Shreyas scythes it over point for one
excellent wide yorker, he can only dig it out back to the bowler although he wanted to go square
short ball to Shreyas now and he's happy to pull it gently to deep midwicket for one
some width outside off from short of length and Shreyas steers it late to deep third for two
short ball does it for Russell! Maybe he wasn't expecting a bouncer with that field, he's a tad late on the pull for the bouncer and gets it only as far as square leg

going straight to the fly slip but the keeper goes for the thick edge off a big swing, and the ball deflects off his glove to send it wide of the slip fielder. He's a mere spectator instead of takin a sitter. Jitesh should have left that one
third wide of the over as he tries to keep it wide of Russell's arc. Too full and wide again
but he tries to bowl one full and wide, too wide and called wide
belligerent! Russell uses his brute force to hammer that full ball on the stumps very straight down the ground, very flat too, for a six between long on and long off
starts with a slow and wide ball outside off, wide of the tram line and called a wide

too full and lofted for six! The line was fine outside off to keep it away from him but it's too full, V Iyer also reaches out to such balls more easily because of his height and he dispatched it straight down the ground
wide and slow outside off, Russell wants to smack it away but can't middle it. Just one
tight ball on off at 98.2kmh, Russell can't clear cover point
just too short and Russell has pounced on it! Rocks back in a flash and muscles the pull over midwicket
shouts of "catch" as he drives inside out in the air from the base of middle but it lands just short
takes a step down and flicks to long-on for one

hint of width outside off and he cuts it with power to cover. The fielder picks it up quickly after a fumble and fires in a throw wide of the keeper for overthrows but the umpire has called it over by now, so sadly for KKR it's a dead ball
a googly outside off, Venkatesh goes for the pull but can't pack much power into it. Just one
short and sharp legbreak outside off, Russell goes back and clips it to leg for one
doesn't middle the cut off the wide ball outside off he's upset with himself
uses his long limbs to plonk his front foot forward and he sweeps the length ball on off for four!
84kmh, quite slow on off and he pushes it to off
nails the yorker at 134kmh on leg and Russell flicks it away for one
a really good short ball, just outside off, and Russell might have been slightly late with his upper cut but the leading edge goes fine on off for four
similar delivery first up to Russell, full and straight on off, and he pushes it back. Curran threatens to throw the ball back but doesn't
131.1kmh, pace does it for Curran! Full and straight on off, nearly in the block hole, quick as well, at least quicker, and Salt misses his hit
slow and wide, he picks the variation and gives it the same treatment! Waits, brings his back foot down flat on the ground and beats long off again
too full outside off and Salt has belted that down the ground, with a knee flat on the ground. Just wide of long-on for six!
in the block hole and Venkatesh digs it out back to Brar
flat to Salt as well and he cuts it fiercely for one more
tries to bluff by making room first but he comes back, slaps the flat ball down to long on
gets a leading edge in the air off the sweep and it goes over Brar to land in nobody's land
comes down the pich and flicks it with the turn wide of long on for two
smashes the ball away to sweeper cover for one
turning a mile away from outside off, Salt reaches out a long way for a single to sweeper cover and keeps strike
turning in and Iyer can't connect the flick, gets a leg bye to leg for one
he takes out the reverse sweep now for the legbreak and does well to send it wide of short third for four!
beats him first ball with a beauty! Rips this legbreak in and through the gate as Iyer reaches out and pokes but is beaten by the turn

they've finally got a wicket and it's of Narine! After three chances that have gone down, Punjab Kings have held on to one. Short and flat outside off, Narine wants to pull it over long-on but he can't get the distance and he holes out
slightly full around off, Salt drills it down to long-off
list a wide yorker, Salt gets close to the length and lofts it straight down but he hasn't got much on that. Lands before long-off
that's so wide outside off it's off the strip and hence a no ball!
slower ball from wide of the crease, Salt reaches out for the ball in the slot outside off and he smacks that over long-on!
Narine walks away to the off side and Harshal follows him, Narine doesn't get pace at 124.3kmh and can only loft it down to long-on
who's gonna fetch that? Slower one at 123.3kmh on the stumps, he flays that down the ground, over long-on's head for a clean six in the crowd
gets the wide yorker right as Narine walks to the off side to target the leg side, but can't connect
starts with one wide outside off, Narine throws his hands at it and gets enough to send it flying over short third to the fence. It was at 123.3kmh, but it doesn't matter to Narine
quick and flat on middle at 95.5kmh, Salt is hit in front of middle but that looked like he nicked it first. Chahar's lbw appeal dies instantly
plays this one also late on the back foot and cuts it behind square for two more

excellent shot in any format of the game! A legbreak without much room outside off, he hangs back to wait for the turn and then punches it away wide of cover for an exquisite cover. Fifty off 25 balls for Salt
a wrong'un going far from him outside off, slapped down to long-off

given out lbw after a long appeal from Chahar and Narine has reviewed it straightaway. He missed the swing on the leg side as the flatter ball went past his bat, struck him almost in front of middle on the back foot, and that's going over leg stump! Narine, you can buy a lottery ticket today (if you get out)
Narine in his element! Dances down to take the length ball on the full, even if it was a googly, and smokes it back over the bowler's head for six
on leg again, this time shorter at 120.5kmh. Not much pace but the bounce is good enough for Salt to help it away behind square in the air and it goes all the way!
it's rarely going to be a dot if you bowl on the pads with fine leg inside the circle. Salt swishes it away from middle and leg and beats the sliding Rossouw in the deep
really slow and wide down leg, third wide of the over
slow, short and wide outside off, Narine goes after it again with a pull but gets only one to leg
a thwack outside off, four more over short third and that's a 23-ball fifty for Narine! It was wide enough outside off to go after it and he did
just wide of the diving deep point fielder. Narine slices the ball with good timing square of the wicket, Rossouw runs to his left and slides but the ball just beat him
slow and wide outside off, well inside the tram line and it beats Narine's wild swing
bangs in a bouncer that's so high over Narine, he doesn't move for it. One for the over too
starts with a wide that's also full outside off
outside off from just short of length, cuts it wide of point for one

third drop of the night! Rabada the fielder this time at backward point. Salt slams that in the air with the ball turning away from him, Rabada throws himself to his right and he also gets both hands to it but it pops out again
goes for a big slog sweep, bit doesn't connect with this well either. A single on the leg side
tries another reverse but misses and he's hit outside leg (his original leg stump)
a legbreak now, but it doesn't matter to Narine! He goes for the reverse and middles that in the air to deep third with disdain
starts with a wrong'un going away from off, Narine pushes it to point
on the stumps on length and he swings across the line for a single to deep midwicket

Salt also gets a life now! Drills the full ball straight down to mid-off where Curran gets one at around chest height, it might have swerved away at the last minute, but it was going in his pocket. Tries with the fingers pointed downwards at that awkward height and can't hold on
another full toss wide off the stumps, at 135.9kmh, and Salt drives it straight to cover again
slightly lucky, Arshdeep, because the attempted wide yorker is a wide ful toss but Salt drives it straight to extra cover
gets the wide worker right at 130.8kmh, Salt chases and misses. Good comeback
takes the pace off but that has so much width that all Salt has to do is slam it over the in-field square on the off side and he'll get four for it

excellent yorker but Narine gets the luck in his favour and collects four more. In the block hole right on leg stump, Narine has to quickly get his feet out of the way to get bat on it, and he gets just enough to get an edge to fine leg with the fielder in the circle
slaps the short ball away to deep midwicket but there's a fielder there
139.1kmh, pace on but he's nailed the yorker. Narine gets an inside edge off the swing to short fine leg for one
this time the pace variation works because doesn't have as much width, Salt steals a quick single after not middling it to point
pace off again, but this time with tempting width and Salt throws his hands at it with some power. Slams it over the covers for four
pace off and outside off with the angle, Salt pokes and misses it

another excellent over for KKR, that's four more! After a six on the leg side, Narine makes room to target the leg side and he gets a full toss, slashes it over the cover-point region for four to make it 21 from the over
bludgeoned! Keep the pace on or take it off, Narine is not going to spare you tonight. Short and slow on the leg side, Narine spots the variation, waits for it and nails the pull
138.9kmh, there is long-on at the fence but Rabada has also gifted Narine with a full toss and he's not going to let that go. Lofts it to the left of long-on in the gap
looked like an attempted yorker which Salt chips over midwicket for one
121.3kmh, Rabada takes the pace off now but he also loses his line. It's a wide down leg
too full outside off, and Salt has put that away with ease for four! Drives it nicely inside-out over the covers for a one-bounce four
the midwicket fielder is at the fence which is why Narine, perhaps, doesn't go all the way with his flick off the pads in the air. Lands in front of him for a single
126.6kmh, nice finish from Harshal. He takes the pace off at 126.6kmh and nails the yorker outside off for a dot. Salt tries to dig it out but misses

the crowd loves it because they've got the ball! Harshal tries something different by going wide of the crease, but Salt doesn't need to move at all because it's angled into him nicely, sat up with the bounce from short of length and he middles that pull over midwicket
a gift from Harshal wrapped in the form of full toss, Salt merely flicks it away over mid-on to get four more. Didn't have to power it much, just placement
Salt is rubbing it in the wounds! He barely middled anything so far but this one is in the slot with the angle into his pads and he flicks that away with perfect timing and roll of the wrists for six

dropped at backward point! It's at 122.5kmh, wide and cutting away, the lack of pace deceives Narine who steers the ball uppishly to point where Brar dives to his right and puts it down after getting both hands to it
angles one sharply into Salt from wide of the crease at 123kmh, Salt miscues and chips it in the air over the umpire luckily for him. Just a single
back to full pace at 138.5kmh, and with the help of away swing he beats Narin'e golf swing outside off

takes the pace off but it's a juicy full toss dipping well outside off and Narine has so much time that he goes back home to Trinidad, returns to Kolkata, and walks to the ball to smoke it down the ground
136.9km, quick and wide this time outside off. Also a wide. Arshdeep is trying to bowl it away from Narine but keeping it too wide
Arshdeep takes the pace off now but also errs with the line. Slow and wide outside off for a wide
132.3kmh, that's the first from Narine and it lands in the crowd! Good pace, good bounce from short length, it's perfect for Narine to pull it away for the cleanest of sixes
fuller now at 132.6kmh outside off and he gets a single wide of mid-off for one. Salt isn't middling those swings
touch wider with the angle, Salt connects for the heave this time but doesn't middle it at all
135.7kh, a lot quicker from Arshdeep outside off with the angle and good pace. Salt swings across the line and misses completely
slow again at 108.1kmh, but with width and Narine lofts that over the covers to the left of deep point for two
stays pretty still this time, goes for another big swing and misses again. A lot slower at 108kmh
survives not by much! Curran goes on the stumps now and Narine jumps a long way to the leg side to make room but misses this swish completely and the ball goes just over the stumps
crunches his first ball through the covers, what a shot first up! Puts side front foot aside and middles that to send it flying in the air
goes after the wider and fuller ball outside off and he sends it flying towards deep backward point for one
123.4kmh, starts gently around leg with no swing on the first ball. Salt tucks it to midwicket

full toss bunted to cover, Kings have pulled off the greatest-ever T20 chase! Not only the highest score ever hunted down in the format, but done with eight wickets standing and more than an over to spare!
short outside off, YJB chops one more to the point sweeper
shuffles across and swats through midwicket
BOOM! Donked down the ground, Shashank ices yet another Dorothy Dix to put Kings on the brink
slower ball, Bairstow mullers six more! This is all over, folks. Stays still in the crease and crashes a drive over long-off as the bowler misses his yorker
short and wide of off, clubbed away to the sweeper
full and wide, sliced for four more! Pace on, 141kph and he just needs to get a chunk on it. Beats the dive of deep third
goes big again, that's his fifty! Sits up for another brutal mow over the leg side. Half-century from 23 balls for Shashank and Kings are bringing this home in KKR's backyard
heave-hooooooooooo! Into the crowd again... short with pace off and Shashank cross-bats it with a vengeance 89m over deep midwicket
slower-ball bumper wide of the stumps. Shashank is on his tippy-toes as he swings and misses... umpires happy it's now wide on height
goes wide blockhole, Bairstow swings hard and toe-ends one out to deep point
clobbered! Short ball, 122kph outside off, Shashank monsters it over deep midwicket! The slower ball gets taken the distance to finish the over perfectly for Kings
over the wicket, superb slower ball! 115kph legcutter and it foxes Shashank as he swings across the line
scooped, all the way over fine leg! Chameera goes pace on but it comes out as a full toss and Shashank is perfectly placed to send it up and away
slips in the wide yorker, 143kph. Beats the bat through to the keeper for a dot ball
slower ball in the channel, creamed into the crowd! Wide line and Shashank steps across to lambast yet another six - the 18th of the innings!
back of a length, Shashank picks out the fielder in the ring

pumped towards deep cover... dropped, and that's his hundred! Not sure it carried to the man in the deep in the end. Bairstow has muscled his way to an extraordinary century, just a few games after being dropped. From 45 balls, at his domineering best. But Kings need him to stay there and finish the job
moves across early, Rana follows him. Short and wide with pace off, 107kph. Cut out to the sweeper for one
length outside off, another cutter from Rana, 115kph. Bairstow chops down for a single behind point
back of a length, pace off... and it skips over the stumps as Bairstow swings hard and misses!
length ball, pace off and worked into the leg side
short, wide and slashed! Steps down and meets it early to carve four past backward point and put the pressure on the bowler
floated up, spinning to leg and Bairstow plays it watchfully into the leg side. He wants two and comes haring back as the throw comes in
tossed up and poked into the covers for one

quicker and flatter outside off, beats the wild swing... and Salt has nudged off the bails, for good measure. The back foot was dragged forward out of his ground, but he was quick to shove it back over the line
flicks out one that goes the other way, beats the outside edge as Shashank pushes forward
pushed through, Bairstow hoicks down the ground without timing. Single to long-on
fizzed down straight, 100kph and flicked off the pads over midwicket
fired down full, 100kph and Shashank squirts a leading edge back over the bowler's head for one
loopy legbreak wide of the stumps, not what Bairstow was expecting. Toe-ended down to long-off
looped up and worked to midwicket
presses forward, inside edge on to pad and it runs away through square leg, into the gap for two
flatter and belted off the back foot! Six-six from Shashank to start the over, as he rocks into a muscular blow over deep midwicket
floated up full, and launched! Stays low, plants the front foot and heaves a brutal hit over deep square leg
pushed through, 98kph on off and worked through square leg for Shashank's first run
scrambled seam, fizzed down wide of off, beats the bat
pushed through, 99kph on the stumps, prodded back to the bowler

miscued, and taken! Narine takes pace off wide of off stump, and brings about the breakthrough! Spun sharply away as Rossouw aimed a blow down the ground, the ball instead looping tamely to mid-off. Eden Gardens finds its voice again
flat outside off, chopped to the point sweeper
slashed away through backward point! Bairstow is channeling Thor tonight. Rocks back and plunders four more on the cut
length in the channel, 135kph. Bairstow powers it out to deep midwicket for one
full outside off, carved out towards deep point, who has work to do and they come back for two
THAT'S OUTTA HERE! Short with pace off, dispatched with interest over deep backward square leg, miles back into the crowd! Measured at 105m
back of a length, hoicked for six more! Easy as you like from YJB as he swivels and clubs the ball over deep backward square
goes for the old-fashioned toe-crusher, 136kph on middle and off. Rossouw digs it out down to long-on
slower ball, slips out wide on the off side. Dew coming in, maybe?
half-tracker and it gets the treatment! Into the pitch and it sits up nicely for Rossouw to batter a pull into the crowd
dug in, short ball... but over the batter's head
short and swatted! This unremitting tonkfest continues as Varun drags one down and Bairstow rocks back to bludgeon a pull over the fence at deep midwicket!
tossed up and boshed straight! Clears the front leg and crunches another boundary over Varun's head
full and pounded over long-off! Fired down at 108kph but sent back with interest as YJB levers it up and away
quick legbreak, beats Bairstow's almighty slog-sweep! That one gripped and turned
into the pitch, 96kph and it loops up, into the gloves outside off. Bairstow foxed
flicked out full, clattered down to long-off
short outside off, Bairstow gets his swipe off the cue end wide of the keeper
short of a length, thumped down the ground. Well cut off by the diving Shreyas at long-on, keeps them to one
dug in and slammed for six! Rossouw connects with this one. Slower ball but it sits up nicely and gets smoked flat over deep square leg
goes for the wide yorker, squirted off the inside edge to short fine leg
short and clubbed! Rocks back and pulls into the gap behind square for another boundary
back of a length and snaking back in, jabbed towards short third
worked into the leg side for one

hammered over wide long-off... dropped on the rope! Fantastic flying effort from the fielder, Anukul, but he can't hold on as he tries to throw the ball back in. Fifty from 23 balls for YJB, who's rediscovered his form in style. One hand off the bat for that one
pushed through outside off and Rossouw crashes a cut to the sweeper
over the wicket to Bairstow, who heaves leg side... Shouts of "catch!" but it bounces short of deep backward square leg
98kph, drops back and slaps to long-on
fired down and heaved away on the sweep-cum-pull, gets a couple behind square
pitched up straight and squirted through square leg off an inside edge
slower ball wide of the stumps, dragged through the leg side for a couple as Shreyas misfields
short and clobbered! Whips the pull away and Russell can't reel it in running around at deep midwicket
full outside off, hint of swing. Bunted down to long-off
full, pace off in the slot... and hammered! Bairstow waits for it and launches the ball over the head of the man on the rope at long-on. Just had enough to clear Shreyas. Brings up the Kings 100, too
length ball wide of the stumps, possibly a cutter. Bairstow chops it to backward point
zipped down on off stump, 99kph and chopped into the covers. Narine applies the sleeper hold, just one off the over
flicked out, 96kph and going away on the angle from over the wicket. Rossouw cuts and misses
quicker, curving in a touch and cramping him for room
flighted on off stump and zipping through past the bat again
rocks back and cuts one to the point sweeper
pushed through, spins a touch and beats the edge as YJB tries to cut

Anukul escapes from the final ball, thick-edged to short fine leg... and Prabhsimran has been run-out from a direct hit! Narine fires down the stumps as they try to scamper one! The crowd erupts, KKR needed that after a blood-and-thunder start to this chase from Kings
sixer, moosed over long-on! Skids into the arc and YJB frees the arms to clatter the ball high over the fence once more
speared in full, crashed through midwicket! Whatever Anukul does he's going the journey. Brings up Punjab Kings' best-ever powerplay score
creamed over cover, four more! Steps away, bottom hand coming off the bat, but still it flies to the fence
ding-dong, Bairstow is on... crumped over deep midwicket! Plants the front dog and hits against the spin, ab-so-lute-ly marmalised 97m into the Eden Gardens crowd
thick-edged past the keeper, Bairstow picks up a boundary to fine leg
sweeps from in front of the stumps, half a shout for lbw. Given as runs
flicked out and spinning back sharply at 97kph, Bairstow hops back but is cramped on the cut
tossed up and worked into the leg side for a single
jumps back and slashes to backward point
launched, all the way! Brings up a tonktastic 18-ball fifty for Prabhsimran! Down on one knee and heaved into the crowd at deep backward square leg
shuffles across and hoicks it around the corner, Prabhsimran lifts Narine's first ball over the circle to fine leg
on the stumps, 103kph and worked off the back foot through midwicket
fired in straight, Prabhsimran turns around early for the reverse-hit... clothed over cover for two
slashed away to deep third! Didn't get hold of it but a thick edge runs away on the bounce
darted outside off, Bairstow thumps into the ground, cover cuts it off but can't prevent one. Brings up Kings' 50
Bairstow pumps this in front of square, drops back and drives through the infield
flat outside off, cut firmly but straight to point
advances, bashed off a length! Prabhsimran finishes the over with his fourth boundary, slapping a slower ball back over the bowler's head. Kings take 23 off the over
into the pitch, 129kph on a wide line, swing and a miss. Was it outside the tramlines? Yes, reckons the ump
straight line, pace off again, 116kph. Nudged into the leg side and they scamper two
slower ball, pumped down the ground - six more! Not sure he timed that at all but he went through with it anyway. Legcutter from Chameera but it disappears 76m over long-off
munched over cover, another boundary! Length ball, 148kph wide of off and Prabhsimran hammers it through the ring
thrashed off a length, picks out cover! That was travelling
ramped over fine leg! Moves well across and takes a length ball, flicked cutely around the corner and it sails for six more. Pace was 149kph and Prabhsimran used it to good effect
slower ball in response, a cutter into the pitch, nurdled to midwicket
short, wide and smoked over the fenced! Pace on, 141kph outside off and Prabhsimran simply goes with it, swatting up and away, into the crowd at deep third!
full, shifts his line around outside off. Bunted into the covers
pick-up whip to leg, goes all the way! Curving into the arc and Prabhsimran hits it out of the park for the first six of the chase
full, pace off and skidding into the front pad as Bairstow plays around it. No real appeal, must have been heading down leg
back of a length and wide of off stump, 139kph. Bairstow swipes at it and bottom edges through to Salt on the bounce
top of off stump, met with a textbook forward defence back to the bowler
hard length, 145kph on fourth stump, tapped down into the off side for one
carved on the up over cover! Touch short and wide, Bairstow steps into an aerial drive in front of point, runs away for the first boundary
length ball angling in on the stumps, worked away through square leg
shortish in the channel outside off, 138kph and YJB thick-edges into his body, the ball running into the off side for the first Kings run
over the wicket, back of a length, 137kph and seaming in sharply... looks like Bairstow has worn this on the ribs!
